svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buy a flanged IP65 box about 100 x 70 x 42 mm with a gasketed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lid; its flange holes go 82 mm apart across the box and 36 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart along it (or move the plate holes to suit your box).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 12 mm holes in the end wall that faces the rod, both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 mm above the box floor's underside: one 12 mm and one 38 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the box side nearest the plate slot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The first takes the M12 gland for the coiled sensor cable, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: second the gland for the reel cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pilot drill 3 mm, open with a step drill at low speed, deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: the three-AA holder on the floor at the far end, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: logger board near the glands, on double-sided foam tape or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flanges flat on the plate, four M4 pan-head screws into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid gasket seats all round; both glands tighten
